ssh_url.title: Ssh Url
ssh_url.description: SSH remote URL to back up this instance's git repository to.

ssh_key_path.title: Ssh Key Path
ssh_key_path.description: Path to the SSH private key to use for the backup remote. If blank, the admin user's key is used.

auto_push_enabled.title: Auto Push Enabled
auto_push_enabled.description: Whether scheduled automatic backups are enabled.

auto_push_minutes.title: Auto Push Minutes
auto_push_minutes.description: Interval, in minutes, between scheduled automatic backups.

resolved_ssh_key.title: Resolved Ssh Key
resolved_ssh_key.description: The SSH key path that would actually be used for the next backup.

uses_admin_key.title: Uses Admin Key
uses_admin_key.description: Whether the resolved SSH key comes from the admin user rather than `ssh_key_path`.

sweep_interval_seconds.title: Sweep Interval Seconds
sweep_interval_seconds.description: How often, in seconds, the backup scheduler wakes up to check whether a push is due.

400.description: Backup URL is not a valid SSH URL, no backup URL was set while enabling scheduled backups, the auto-push interval is out of range, no SSH key is available to check the remote, or the remote repository is not empty (or could not be checked)
